Chapters read only from saved files. They never call an API while rendering.

title: 4  JSON files and APIs
text:
4.3 Part 2: APIs (fetch, then process)
Run the fetch once in the console or a script, commit the saved file, and keep the call in the chapter with eval: false so readers can see how the data were obtained.

source(here::here("R", "fetch_helpers.R"))

fetch_cached(
  url   = "https://example.org/api/endpoint",
  path  = here::here("data", "raw", "example_YYYY-MM-DD.json"),
  query = list(param = "value")
)

The chapter then reads only the saved file:

raw <- jsonlite::read_json(
  here::here("data", "raw", "example_YYYY-MM-DD.json"),
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)
